loothub.screen.select_hint: Select an item on the left
loothub.job.editor.title: Move job widget
loothub.job.editor.hint: Drag to move · drag edges/corners to resize · right-click: 100 %
loothub.job.editor.no_data: No job data yet – example display. Enable real values with /job toggle.
loothub.update.install.tooltip: Installed: %s · New: %s – active after a restart
loothub.update.restart.tooltip: Restart Minecraft to activate the new version
loothub.update.notice: [Loothub+] Update %s available – install it in the Loothub+ menu (key L), changes under “Changelog”.
loothub.history.empty: No job sessions yet – enable the display with /job toggle
loothub.stats.col.name: Name
loothub.stats.empty: Nothing counted yet – statistics run as soon as you play on a server
loothub.stats.note: Loothub+'s own count since installation (servers only). Killed mobs are estimated.
loothub.settings.job_widget.tooltip: Shows job, level, progress, tracking time, money and XP (total and per hour) in game, plus the value of your inventory. Job values need /job toggle.
loothub.settings.tooltip_prices.tooltip: Shows the current marketplace prices when hovering over an item in your inventory.
loothub.settings.stats.tooltip: Counts blocks, distances, items, mobs, damage and play time on servers – see “Statistics”.
loothub.settings.update_check.tooltip: Looks for a new version on GitHub when the game starts. If there is one, a button to install it appears at the top.
loothub.update.reason.not_found: Update repository not found or private
loothub.update.reason.rate_limited: GitHub limit reached, try again later
loothub.update.reason.no_file: No mod file in the release
loothub.tab.market.header: Market prices from the OPSUCHT marketplace
loothub.settings.quick_panel.tooltip: Shows buttons for important commands below the inventory (key E). Drag buttons to reorder, move the bar by its header; “Lock” keeps everything in place.
loothub.settings.pulse.tooltip: Lets the red borders around inventory, recipe book and command bar pulse slowly. Off: solid dark red border.
loothub.settings.sell_highlight.tooltip: Highlights all items traded on the marketplace in green in the server's market menus (e.g. “Sell items”) – also in your own inventory.
loothub.settings.pcg.tooltip: Reads the Twitch chat and shows the wild Pokémon with its catch time at the top right. Above the inventory there are buttons to throw and buy balls (sending only with a token).
loothub.tab.merchant.header: What the resource merchant currently accepts
loothub.merchant.error: Rates could not be loaded – try again later.
loothub.merchant.empty: The merchant accepts nothing right now.
loothub.pcg.editor.title: Move Pokémon display
loothub.settings.pcg_sound.tooltip: Plays a short sound when a new Pokémon appears in the Pokémon Community Game.
loothub.settings.quick_buttons.tooltip: Which buttons the command bar shows:
loothub.tab.pokedex.header: Pokédex for the Pokémon Community Game
loothub.pokedex.empty: Still empty – every Pokémon you catch lands here automatically.
loothub.settings.music.tooltip: Shows what is playing in the HUD: YouTube Music in the browser/as a web app (via Windows) or the desktop app with the “API Server” plugin.
loothub.settings.tool_protection.tooltip: Warns and locks the tool as soon as its durability reaches the limit.
loothub.settings.theme.tooltip: Inner: accents in menus and inventory · Outer: frames · Pulse: colour of the pulsing border. Opacity applies to all Loothub backgrounds.
loothub.settings.theme.inner.title: Inner colour (accents, inventory)
loothub.settings.theme.outer.title: Outer colour (frames)
loothub.settings.theme.pulse.title: Pulse colour
loothub.quickedit.title: Command bar buttons
loothub.quickedit.hint: ✎ edit · ✖ delete · reorder by dragging in the bar
loothub.quickedit.name: Name
loothub.settings.inv_hud.tooltip: Always shows your inventory above the hotbar.
loothub.music.editor.title: Move music display
loothub.settings.hide_head.tooltip: Hides items worn on the head (e.g. the car) – on you and on other players. Real helmets of others stay visible. Only you see the difference.
loothub.inv_hud.editor.title: Move inventory display
loothub.settings.hide_offhand.tooltip: Hides talisman backpacks in the off hand – on you (also first person) and on other players. Only you see the difference.
loothub.treasure.chance: [Loothub+] 100,000 job XP reached – chance of a job treasure!
loothub.settings.treasure.tooltip: Counts job XP up to 100,000; it resets to 0 on “job treasure received”. Correct the value here:
loothub.treasure.found: [Loothub+] Job treasure received (%s.) – counter is back at 0.
loothub.tab.itemdex.header: All server items you have come across
loothub.itemdex.empty: Still empty – every server item you see lands here automatically.
loothub.settings.inventory_design.toolti: Black and red inventory, “Loothub+” heading with buttons in the inventory and easy-to-read menu titles.
loothub.settings.amount_shortcut.tooltip: 1m, 2.5k or 3b in /bank, /clan bank, /pay and the auction house are sent as the full number.
loothub.settings.rename_window.tooltip: /rename or /sign without text opens a window with colours, formatting and preview.
loothub.settings.itemdex.tooltip: Automatically adds server items you come across to the Itemdex.
loothub.settings.pcg.status.no_channel: Channel not found – check the channel name
loothub.merchant.daily.unknown: Open the resource merchant in game once – then it appears here.
loothub.merchant.daily.old: From an earlier day – open the merchant
loothub.settings.container_value.tooltip: Shows the market value of the contents next to opened chests, barrels and shulker boxes (and OPShards at the resource merchant).
loothub.settings.market_sales.tooltip: Money you collect at the marketplace (one by one or all at once) appears as “Market” in the job history.
loothub.settings.afk_view.tooltip: After 5 minutes without moving, your character lies down and the camera slowly glides out – also with chat open. Walking or jumping makes it stand up again. Looking around with the mouse does not count, holding a fishing rod keeps you awake. Other players who don't move for 5 minutes lie down too. Only visible to you.
loothub.settings.minime.tooltip: Up to 6 small companions, each with the skin of any player – leave the field empty = free slot.
loothub.settings.aura.tooltip: Glowing energy licking upwards around your body – in any colour.
loothub.tab.cosmetics.header: Mini-Mes, aura and more – visible to everyone with Loothub+
loothub.cosmetics.show.desc: Show cosmetics on all players who have some (including your own).
loothub.inv.store_matching: Store matching (only items already in the chest)
loothub.cosmetics.preview.hint: Drag with the mouse to rotate the figure
loothub.cosmetics.first_person.desc: Also show pets and the free Mini-Mes (flying, crawling) in first person.
loothub.cosmetics.share.desc: Your selection is shared automatically with everyone who has Loothub+. Copy as a backup:
loothub.cosmetics.wings.desc: Large wings on your back that flap gently.
loothub.settings.hide_cape.tooltip: Hides the cape on your own player. Only you see the difference. LabyMod cosmetic capes are drawn by LabyMod itself – turn those off there.
loothub.settings.fly_pose.tooltip: When you fly forward fast (e.g. sprint flying), you lie flat in the air – head first, both arms at your sides. Normal hovering stays upright. Arms stay normal while mining and hitting.
loothub.cosmetics.minime_wings.desc: Every Mini-Me gets its own wings – sitting, flying or crawling.
loothub.cosmetics.pets.desc: Up to two companions in addition to the Mini-Mes, further out beside you.
loothub.cosmetics.emotes.desc: Mini-Mes wave, scratch their heads and dangle their legs when you stand still, cheer on job level-ups, dance to music, play rock-paper-scissors and stretch in AFK sleep. Key B opens the emote wheel.
loothub.cosmetics.eyes.desc: Your eyes glow in the chosen colour – even in the dark.
loothub.cosmetics.crown.desc: A small golden crown floats above your head and slowly turns.
loothub.cosmetics.footsteps.desc: Sparks or small flames and some ground crumbs stay behind when you walk – in water the flames go out with a hiss.
loothub.cosmetics.footsteps.label: Trail
loothub.cosmetics.flytrail.desc: In the flight pose you pull a tail of aura flames behind you (only with the aura switched on).
loothub.cosmetics.auralevels.desc: When you sprint or fly, the aura grows bigger and brighter – at the highest level lightning flickers.
loothub.cosmetics.wing_color.desc: Inner = membrane or feathers, outer = bones and edge. ↺ = original colours.
loothub.cosmetics.minime.rows.desc: Per Mini-Me: player name (empty = free slot; Bedrock players with a dot in front, e.g. “.Gamertag”), wings and two wing colours (inner/outer).
loothub.cosmetics.risetrail.desc: When you fly up or down, a burst of energy breaks out behind you – flickering light beams and shock waves, under your feet when rising, above your head when sinking.
loothub.settings.look_info.tooltip: Shows what you are looking at: block with icon and name, the right tool with ✔/✖ and the market price (each can be turned off). Use “Move …” or drag it in chat to place it elsewhere.
loothub.settings.ore_glow.tooltip: Visible ores near you get a pulsing, glowing outline in their colour – diamond turquoise, gold yellow, redstone red … Only faces you can see anyway; nothing shows through walls.
loothub.look_info.editor.title: Move block info
loothub.look_info.editor.hint: Drag to the desired place with the mouse
loothub.sign.title: Write sign
loothub.settings.sign_window.tooltip: Writing on a sign opens a Loothub window: four lines, colour and format buttons (&-codes), live preview and how much space is left per line.
loothub.settings.rarity_frames.tooltip: Items with “Rarity » …” in their tooltip get a frame in the colour of their rarity in the inventory (e.g. Legendary).
loothub.settings.chat_time.tooltip: Every chat message starts with the time it arrived.
loothub.settings.chat_copy.tooltip: Clicking a chat message copies its text. Links and commands in messages keep working as usual.
loothub.settings.chat_mention.tooltip: When you are mentioned in chat, the line gets a golden marker and your name glows gold.
loothub.settings.chat_mention_sound.tool: A quiet sound when you are mentioned in chat.
loothub.chatpage.filter.hint: Messages containing these words are hidden from chat (case-insensitive).
loothub.alltag.name: Name
loothub.alltag.empty: No timers yet – create one above.
loothub.alltag.jobs.hint: Average over the whole job history (active time only).
loothub.alltag.jobs.empty: No job data yet – just work a bit.
loothub.timer.done_late: ⏰ Timer finished (while the game was closed): %s
loothub.timer.editor.title: Move timer display
loothub.settings.chat_filter.tooltip: Hides messages with these words in every chat – also the normal Minecraft chat.
loothub.settings.timers.tooltip: Countdowns and daily reminders with display and sound. Create them in the menu under “Timer”. Watched auctions automatically get their own timer there.
loothub.settings.compressor_icon.tooltip: Shows a small icon on the compressor in your inventory and hotbar of what it compresses. Open the compressor menu once and Loothub remembers its targets. Several alternate.
loothub.settings.durability_numbers.tool: Shows the remaining durability small in the top left of the slot.
loothub.settings.drop_protection.tooltip: Valuable items (rarity, custom name, enchanted) only drop on the second throw in quick succession.
loothub.settings.custom_chat.tooltip: Replaces the Minecraft chat with your own windows: move and resize in the open chat, tabs, colors, text size. Right-click a message to move its source (e.g. OPSUCHT, player chat) into a tab. ⚙ opens settings.
loothub.chatwin.title: Chat window
loothub.chatwin.tab.name: Name
loothub.chatwin.sources.all: Sources: all – click to narrow down
loothub.chatassign.title: Assign message
loothub.chatassign.source: Source: %s – all messages from this source into …
loothub.chatassign.only: Only show there (remove from other tabs)
loothub.history.clear.question: Really delete the whole job history? This cannot be undone.
loothub.stats.clear.question: Really delete all statistics? This cannot be undone.
loothub.cosmetics.life.desc: How alive the Mini-Mes look: breathing, dangling legs, bouncing, bobbing in flight, looking around, flinching at damage and lightning, ducking and hopping with you, chatting and playing together, getting tired at night, waving at other Mini-Mes, reacting to mentions and private messages. 0 % = calm.
loothub.cosmetics.trait.desc: Give each Mini-Me its own nature: playful (waves and plays more), shy (stays with you, startles easily), brave (looks at strangers, barely flinches), lazy (yawns, tires quickly), curious (always looking around).
loothub.settings.shader.tooltip: Own shader pack: color grading, bloom, vignette, haze. Turning it on selects it in Iris and reloads shaders; turning it off disables shaders. Sliders under Iris → Shader options.
loothub.settings.shader.no_iris: Needs the Iris mod – not installed.
loothub.settings.offhand.tooltip: Chosen items in the off hand aren't used on right-click – e.g. the fishing rod won't be cast. Shields, totems etc. work as usual.
loothub.chatassign.hide: Hide messages like this in tab “%s”
loothub.command.too_fast: Loothub: command not sent – please wait a moment
loothub.settings.streamer.tooltip: Adds the “Streamer” page to the menu: connect your Twitch account, show Twitch chat in Minecraft chat and list redeemed channel point rewards in the HUD to tick off.
loothub.tab.streamer.header: Streamer – Twitch account, chat and stream events
loothub.streamer.disconnect.confirm: Really disconnect %s? The login is revoked on Twitch. The reward list is kept.
loothub.streamer.no_client: Twitch connection is not set up in this version yet.
loothub.streamer.no_client.sub: Coming with one of the next updates.
loothub.streamer.not_connected.sub: Log in via twitch.tv/activate – no password in Minecraft.
loothub.streamer.enter_code: Enter this code on twitch.tv/activate (page was opened):
loothub.streamer.clear_done.confirm: Delete all ticked stream events from the list?
loothub.streamer.relogin.hint: Reconnect once for follows, polls & more
loothub.settings.connected_textures.tool: Glass (stained and tinted too) without borders between equal blocks – a glass wall looks like one big pane. Works with any resource pack.
loothub.settings.crown.tooltip: Shows a small crown in the tab list in front of every player who also uses Loothub.
loothub.tab.fishing.header: Fishing log – caught fish with size and rarity
loothub.fishing.clear.question: Really delete the whole fishing log? This cannot be undone.
loothub.settings.sound_volume.tooltip: Volume of each Loothub sound type – 0 % mutes it.
loothub.settings.timer_sound.tooltip: Which sound plays when a timer ends.
loothub.settings.hud_layout.tooltip: Move all Loothub displays on one screen – with the mouse or arrow keys.
loothub.hud_layout.title: HUD positions
loothub.hud_layout.hint: Drag a box, or click it and use the arrow keys (Shift = big steps)
loothub.settings.fish_alert.tooltip: Shows caught fish in the style of the Twitch alerts, coloured by rarity, with sound. Choose below which rarities appear.
loothub.settings.inv_sort.tooltip: Sort inventory and chests: press your key over the area you want sorted, or use the ⇅ button. Equal stacks are merged. Set the key under Options › Controls › Loothub+.
loothub.settings.inv_move.tooltip: Press your key in a chest: moves every item that already exists on the other side; with Shift everything. Over the inventory in, over the chest out. Set the key under Options › Controls › Loothub+.
loothub.settings.auto_refill.tooltip: When the stack in your hand runs out, the next matching stack from your inventory is put in automatically.
loothub.settings.tool_saver.tooltip: Right before a tool breaks it is swapped for an equal one with more durability – or put into your inventory if there is none.
loothub.settings.composer.tooltip: Prepare a message with /chat: colour codes by click, live preview, send or copy. /chat <text> pre-fills the field.
loothub.settings.fish_chat_hide.tooltip: Hides the “You caught …” message in chat. The catch still lands in the fishing log and the catch alert.
loothub.settings.fish_sound.tooltip: Mutes the sound OPSUCHT plays on a catch – only while you hold a fishing rod. Ticked = muted:
loothub.settings.fish_sound.learning: Loothub learns the catch sound by itself: after a few catches it appears here and is muted while fishing.
loothub.settings.bait_warning.tooltip: When OPSUCHT reports that your bait is used up, a big red warning with an alarm appears.
loothub.settings.pokedex_page.tooltip: Shows the “Pokédex” page in the menu. Off: page hidden, caught Pokémon stay saved.
loothub.composer.title: Prepare message
loothub.composer.note.save.tooltip: Saves the text from the field to the notepad so you can insert it again later with one click.
loothub.composer.notes.empty: Nothing saved yet – type a text and click “Save to notepad”.
loothub.emotes.title: Gestures
loothub.settings.auction_alarm.tooltip: Shortly before a watched auction (Merkliste) ends, an alert with sound appears. Open the watch list now and then to make the time more precise.
loothub.backup.restored.title: Loothub data restored
loothub.cosmetics.others.desc: Show other players' Mini-Mes and pets only nearby or only for the closest players – helps in crowded places.
loothub.alltag.shown.tip: Show or hide in the HUD (at most %s at once)
loothub.alltag.shown.limit: At most %s timers shown at once – hide another one first
loothub.cosmetics.seasonal.desc: From December 1 to January 6 the Mini-Mes wear Santa hats, and on New Year's Eve small firework sparks rise up.
